t: 10 Ways to Buy More Time
s: September 3, 2025 - From checking social media to texting family and friends to surfing the internet, our workdays are wrought with distractions that impact our ability to focus and use our time effectively and efficiently. According to more than fifteen years of published research by Statista.com, 41-49% of adults experience stress over not having enough time to do the things they wanted to do. But given how unproductive most of us are with our time, the adage that you can’t buy more time is a bit of a false narrative.

t: Working More Doesn’t Make You More Productive | TIME
s: January 13, 2026 - In fact, it could do more harm than good. In today’s knowledge economy and tomorrow's AI reality, the most successful individuals, organizations, and nations won’t be those that work the most hours, but those who are most effective at making their working hours count. ... Redefining productivity for the 21st century, however, requires making big, often difficult changes to longstanding workplace norms, and likely won’t succeed without enthusiastic employee buy-in.
